friction_factors.explanation: Difficulty navigating online portals, OTP verifications, and digital appointment slots.

friction_factors.explanation: Hospital visit causes loss of daily earnings; requires exact-time OPD token to minimize waiting.

friction_factors.explanation: Patient lacks dedicated family member to assist with hospital navigation and registration queues.

friction_factors.explanation: Missing or unorganized physical ID/insurance cards causing registration friction.
friction_factors.suggested_intervention: Upload and verify documents in digital Document Vault before leaving home.

friction_factors.explanation: Preferred communication in local language (PA) rather than complex medical English.
friction_factors.suggested_intervention: Provide multilingual vernacular forms and audio-assisted summaries.

friction_factors.mechanismexplanation: Incomplete physical scheme credentials coupled with lack of digital scanning tools prevents pre-authorization under welfare schemes (e.g. Ayushman Bharat/PM-JAY).
friction_factors.recommendedmitigation: Facilitate on-ground document verification at local Common Service Center (CSC) or Gram Panchayat office.
